column4: sunny low-poly garden at eye level: hedges and walls taller than the walker, arch brightest, red twin through it; stairs and bridge in evidence/t-l5-start.png
first person, clean spaces, an opening onto a space that cannot fit; no named game's art or levels used
3D, first person at eye height; mouse look with smoothing is in the code (index.html:124), the feel of it is the person's to judge
the red garden has a wall where the green has none (index.html:548); sheds, ponds and bridges differ by life in space 5
walked through the first arch in the check run with the view continuous; index.html:734
the 2.8 m shed's door shows and leads to a 34 m hall
the seam on the north path cannot be seen; the scripted run round the pillar arrived at the gate yard, not the start (index.html:565)
from the south the door shows the high walkway; from the north the red cellar (evidence/t-l4-north.png)
the scripted runs carried cubes through arches and doors onto switches in spaces 3, 4 and 5 and the doors opened
five spaces played from the title to the ending in one scripted run (evidence/run-l12.txt to run-l5.txt)
the gate lights and a chime is called when a space is solved; the sound itself was not heard by the check
arches between the colourful and the red life, walked through
bigger inside, a path that changes, a door with two sides
cube and switch puzzles in spaces 3, 4 and 5, each solved in the scripted run
the start faces the glowing arch with red ground in it
in the red life after walking through; the green garden shows in the arch looking back
the red wall blocks the north; the second arch in the hedge leads back to green and past it
tiny shed, long hall inside
the hall's gate lights within 9 m; the run won the space there
space 3 is the first with a cube, a switch and a door; when a player reaches it was not timed
the switch is in the colourful yard, the cube in the red copy of it one turn round the pillar; going on round ends at a pond, going back is the answer
no death; R reloads the space; a cube put in the pond returns to where it began (the return was not exercised in a run)
space 4 has the two-sided door; space 5 has the shed bigger inside whose pillar path changes where its door leads
